content:
Registration for the next Workshop that BUILT CoLAB is organising in the framework of the “Circularity in Construction” initiative is now open.

📢 Workshop | Innovation for a more circular construction

📅 Thursday 03 February | ⏰15:00 – 17:00 |

Orador Principal: Ana Quintas | The Cradle to Cradle Products Innovation Institute

Presentation of Innovative Case Studies: “R2CS Network”, by Carla Pires | Gaiurb, “EEAgrants Circular2B”, by Nuno Ramos | FEUP, “EEAgrants (Des)construir”, by Luísa Magalhães | Smart Waste Portugal

This Workshop aims to promote debate on innovation in the construction sector for a more circular transition, its contribution to the New European Bauhaus, identification of key areas for investment, and gather and select key ideas to explore in Living Labs.

The keynote speaker will make an approach to the topic under discussion, and will include the presentation of some innovative practical cases, followed by a round table, open to questions from the participants and moderated by António Aguiar Costa.

Participation is free of charge, but registration is required here.

This Workshop takes place within the scope of the Circular Agreement with the Construction Industry, the Collaboration Protocol between BUILT CoLAB, the Ministry for the Environment and Climate Action and the Environmental Fund, and also has as partner entities the Confederation of Portuguese Industry (CIP), the CPCI – Portuguese Confederation of Construction and Real Estate, AICCOPN – Association of Civil Construction and Public Works Industrialists, AECOPS – Association of Construction and Public Works and Services Companies, PTPC – Portuguese Technological Platform for Construction, IMPIC – Institute for Public Markets, Real Estate and Construction, I. P., and the APA – Portuguese Environment Agency, I. P..

Meet all the partners and learn more about the initiatives under this agreement at https://circularidade.builtcolab.pt/.
